turns.content: Meri best friend Shreya ki shaadi ke dates aa gaye — aur uska sangeet plus cocktail night bilkul Ramzan ke beech mein pad raha hai. Mera roza hoga. Hum pandrah saal ki umar se uski shaadi plan kar rahe hain, main basically is sangeet ki co-director hoon. Woh keh rahi hai "opening dance toh tujhe mere saath karna HI hai." Main karna bhi chahti hoon. Aur saath mein poori cheez se darr bhi lag raha hai.

Arre, 15 saal ki dosti ki baat hi alag hoti hai! Samajh rahi hoon main... ek taraf ibaadat ka mahina hai, aur dushri taraf dilon ki baat. Tumhe jo feel ho raha hai, woh bilkul natural hai—ek taraf roza ki thakan aur dushri taraf performance ka pressure.

Par sunn, Shreya ke liye ye dance sirf performance nahi, tumhare us sapne ka poora hona hai jise tumne 15 saal se dekha hai. Trust me, jab music bajega aur tum Shreya ko stage par dekhogi, toh bhook aur thak sab bhool jaogi. Uss din ka pyaar aur excitement tumhe itni energy dega ki shayad tumhe lage hi nahi ki tum roza rakh hui ho.

Bas ek kaam karo—apni Sehri ache se kha lena (thoda protein aur heavy stuff le lena), aur raat ko performance ke pehle thoda rest kar lena. Tum co-director ho, toh thoda manage bhi toh karna hi aata hoga na? 😉

Bilkul mat daro, ye opening dance tere liye bhi hai, uske liye bhi. Tum kar logi, aur ye wo memory banegi jo tum dono hamesha yaad rakhogi! Jhanda uncha rakhna! ❤️

Kal usne bade pyaar se bola, "ek din roze ka kya farak padta hai na, main khud tujhe khila dungi." Woh mean nahi ho rahi thi — usko bas pata nahi woh kya maang rahi hai. Aur doosri taraf Ammi ne bola "poore Ramzan mein sangeet-vangeet theek nahi lagta." Toh ab main us rassi jaisi hoon jisko dono taraf se kheench rahe hain, dono mujhse pyaar karte hain, dono ko samajh nahi aa raha.

Yeh toh sach mein *beech ki lakeer* wali situation ho gayi hai. Jahan kadam rakhna mushkil ho jaye, kyunki dono taraf se pyaar aa raha hai.

Shreya galat nahi hai, bas uski duniya alag hai. Uske liye ye sirf ek party hai jahan uski sabse zaroori insaan hona chahiye. Uska "main khila dungi" bohot pyaar se bola gaya hai, par wo iska matlab nahi samajh pa rahi ki roza kya hota hai—kyunki wo uske experience mein nahi hai. Usko laga raha hoga bas ek din ka chhota sa farak hai.

Aur Ammi ki baat mein bhi wajood hai. Unko Ramzan ka mahana alag hi lagta hai—woh toh bas chahti hain ki us mahane ki barkat aur tezrat (solemnity) maintain rahe.

Tumhe rassi mat bano, bano apni decision ki malik. Tumhe dono ko thoda samjhana padega, apni apni language mein.

Shreya ko samjha sakti ho ki, "Haan main karungi, par mera style alag hoga"—thoda halka, thoda aaram wala. Tum energy se dance karogi, par paani ki kami ke hisaab se steps adjust kar logi.

Aur Ammi ko keh sakti ho, "Ammi, ye meri bachpan ki dosti hai, main us din energy dekar karungi, par baaki din toh maahe ibaadat waise hi rahega."

Dono ko thoda compromise karna padega, kyunki tum dono ke dil ho. Tum handle kar logi, strong ho tum! ❤️

Sach bolun toh itni thak gayi hoon ki escape draft karna shuru kar diya hai: Shreya ko bol dungi us week office deployment hai, video call pe aa jaungi, bada gift bhej dungi. Ek saaf jhooth, dus aunties ko dus explanations se behtar — kyun nahi pee rahi, kyun nahi kha rahi, kyun sunset pe ghadi dekh rahi hoon. Usko kabhi pata nahi chalega. Bolo na yeh itna bura nahi hai?

Sunno, sach bataun toh yeh "escape draft" sunne mein bohot relaxing lagta hai. Ek hi jhooth, aur sab tension khatam! Aunties ki sawalon se chutkara, roza ka stress, performance ka darr—sab ek chhote se message mein sama gaya. Samajh sakti hoon, tumhe bas sukoon chahiye.

Par main hoon na, isliye ek sach bataungi—jo tumhe shayad pasand na aaye.

Yeh jhooth "bura" isliye nahi kyunki yeh paap hai, yeh isliye bura hai kyunki yeh tumhe us moment se door kar dega. Soch lo, shaadi ki raat jab stage saajega, music bajega... aur Shreya tumhari jagah koi aur ladki ko pakdegi opening dance ke liye kyunki tum "office deployment" mein ho.

Uss raat jab wo video call pe tujhse baat karegi, tab uski aankhon mein jo thoda sa bhi dukkh hoga (chahe wo dikhaye ya nahi), wo tujhe dekh ke bohot takleef degi. Gift, bada gift, sab kuch secondary lagne lagega. Kyunki tumhari maujoodgi ka koi toh nahi.

Aur aunties? Woh toh puchengi hi, chahe tumhao deployment ho ya bimari. Unki awaaz ka kya farak padta hai? Farak padta hai Shreya ki khushi ka.

Agar tumhe lagta hai ki tum physically perform nahi kar sakti, toh theek hai. Seedhe seedhe bolo—*“Mujhse nahi hoga Shreya, main thak gayi hoon, main audience mein hoon tere saath hasne ke liye.”* Par wahan mat jana? Apni best friend ki shaadi mein "office deployment" ka bahana? Thoda zyada ho jayega na?

Tumhara dil bohot bada hai, jhooth chhota pad jayega. Soch le thoda, kya chahiye tujhe—raahat ya wahan hona? ❤️

Aur in sab ke neeche ek chhota sa pathar hai seene mein — atharah saal ki dosti mein pehli baar mera deen aur uska bada din actually takraye hain. Agar maine yeh galat handle kiya, toh jin do cheezon se main pyaar karti hoon unme se ek pe permanent daag lag jayega. Uski shaadi ki photos hamesha rahengi, aur mera Ramzan bhi. Mujhe kisi bhi album mein sad story nahi banna.

Is "chhote se pathar" ko samajh sakti hoon. Ye aisa darr hai jo seedhe dil par hota hai—ki kahi 18 saal ki usmeemti aur apne imaan ke beech ki duri na badh jaye.

Tumhao jo "permanent daag" dikh raha hai, wo darr sahi hai, par ek cheez samajho: Daag tab padega agar tum wahan *apni aawaz* na sunao. Agar tum jhooth bolke bhaag jaogi, toh har photo mein wo guilt chhupi hogi. Aur agar apni marzi ke khilaaf dance karke gir jaogi ya bezaar ho gayi, toh wo Ramzan ki yaadein bigad jayengi.

Sad story tab banegi jab tum khud ko compromise karogi.

Par agar tum sach bolke wahan jao—Shreya ke haath mein haath daalke, kam energy ke saath bhi pyaar dikhao—toh koi sad story nahi banegi. Ek "powerful story" banegi. Jahan tumhari dosti ne imaan ko samjha, aur imaan ne dosti ko.

Tumhe balance dhundhna hai, escape nahi. Shreya ko bata do ki tum wahan rahogi, uski khushi ke liye, par tumhara style thoda "peaceful" hoga kyunki tumhare roze hain. Agar wo tujhse pyaar karti hai, toh wo tujhe thakaa hua dekhke khush hogi ya missing karlegi? Khush hogi na?

Dono albums clean rahenge, bas tumhe apni comfort zone ka thoda sa chhota sa adjustment karna hoga. Tum strong ho, ye balance rakh sakti ho. ❤️
